pinev: Town where he died (death index); farm not located. Pin on Minonk (40.9045,-89.0345).

tw-il-eureka-onnen-henhouse.st: The Illinois death index gives his death as 24 Oct 1941 at Minonk, in the NE of Woodford County; Eureka is the county seat, where the court case was heard.
src: Illinois Deaths and Stillbirths index: Henry W. Onnen, b. 23 Apr 1875, d. 24 Oct 1941, Minonk (Ancestry, PC (b))
